subject: Paid {tier} order without a licence
preview: A customer paid for {tier}, but the order matches no account, so no licence was granted.
heading: A paid order has no licence
intro: Polar reported a paid {tier} order whose customer matches no account here, so no licence was granted. The buyer has paid and has no licence key yet.
recovery: To grant the licence, find or create the buyer’s account, set the Polar customer’s external ID to the account’s ID, then redeliver the order’s order.paid and benefit_grant.created webhook events in Polar. The admin dashboard lists the order until it has a licence.
